/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 17-year-old boy presents for a psychotherapy session after finding out that his girlfriend has been carrying on another relationship with someone else. He expresses rage and complains of difficulty focusing on his upcoming high school comedy club routines and upcoming track meet. His therapist, while explaining the concept of defense mechanisms, describes some hypothetical examples related to the situation. Which of the following potential actions by this patient would be an example of sublimation?

Options:
A. Channeling his anger about the situation into training for his track meet
B. Instigating a physical fight with his girlfriend’s other partner
C. Making jokes about the situation and incorporating them into his comedy routine
D. Not thinking about the upsetting situation now or in the future
E. Not thinking about the upsetting situation until after his track meet, then confronting and processing his feelings about it

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question concerns psychotherapy, defense mechanisms, and sublimation, which are within the scope of psychiatry and mental health."}
